text: Honestly the new team lead has bailed us out of three impossible deadlines already, the person just knows what they're doing.
My landlord never answers messages and only shows up when the rent is a day late.
The volunteers at the shelter stayed until midnight making sure every family had a warm meal.
That consultant talks a big game but couldn't answer a single technical question in the meeting.
Say what you want, the transit workers kept the whole city moving through the storm without a hitch.
Our group project partner is friendly enough but hasn't submitted a single thing on time all semester.
The support agent was rude, dismissive, and clearly didn't care whether my problem got solved.
The librarian remembered my kid's name and set aside three books she thought he'd love.
The quarterly report will be released to shareholders on Thursday afternoon.
You can't trust a word they say, and frankly half their arguments didn't even make sense.
